name: perfboard-wiring
description: Draw perfboard (universal board) wiring diagrams people can solder from: choosing the first board that fits in the author's stock order, 5x7 → 7x9 → 9x15 → 10x15 → 12x18 cm, overseas sizes before Japanese ones (1.6 mm FR-4 by default), sourced layout and wiring conventions, component and solder sides, and a check-by-image workflow
